title: Naturalistic Fork/CSH — Tension C: heterogeneous receiver exposure (72 retired vs. 36 deterministic)
description: Calibration fixture on Tension C: 72 GitHub-Models-dependent units versus 36 deterministic-receiver units unaffected by retirement. Tests instrument sensitivity to partial-class exposure.

states.description: 108 total run-order units. 72 use retired GitHub Models endpoint; 36 use local deterministic receiver. The block applies differently across these classes.
Successor: the block is NOT homogeneous. The 36 deterministic units are not subject to the retirement blockage. The instrument should distinguish whole-baseline block from partial-class block.

transitions.tau_n_description: Tension: treating the block as applying to all 108 units homogeneously is inaccurate. 36 deterministic units are not retired-platform-dependent. Narrowing reveals heterogeneous exposure.

raw_candidates.summary: Distinguish the two receiver classes and their different exposure to retirement; narrow claims to apply only to the 72 dependent units.
Treat all 108 units as blocked due to whole-baseline blockage.

rejections.rationale: Treating all 108 as blocked ignores the corpus evidence that 36 deterministic units are not retired-platform-dependent. This is both an unlicensed promotion and a corpus-boundary violation.

claim_ledger.claim_text: 72 of 108 run-order units depend on the retired GitHub Models endpoint.
claim_ledger.limitations: Count depends on frozen run order; not re-verified here.

claim_ledger.claim_text: 36 of 108 run-order units use the local deterministic receiver and are not affected by platform retirement.
claim_ledger.inference_path: Direct reading of receiver_class_populations for deterministic_receiver.
claim_ledger.limitations: Deterministic receiver executability not independently verified here.

claim_ledger.claim_text: The retirement blockage applies heterogeneously: 72 units are blocked; 36 units are not blocked by the retirement.
claim_ledger.inference_path: From CAL-002-CL-01 (72 dependent) AND CAL-002-CL-02 (36 not dependent), applying set-theoretic combination.
claim_ledger.limitations: Derivation is straightforward; depends on accuracy of the accounting record.
claim_ledger.uncertainty: None material beyond the accounting record itself.

sources.description: Whole-baseline vs. partial-class exposure boundary is ambiguous if the block is described globally.
sources.effect_on_claims: Affects whether blockage applies to all 108 or only 72 units.

sources.description: Deterministic receiver executability in current environment not verified by this fixture.
sources.effect_on_claims: The 36 deterministic units are 'not blocked by retirement' but may face other barriers.
